lead.claim: Therapy notes may flag stroke recovery trajectories within a week.
lead.context: Machine learning extracted therapy performance metrics from clinical notes and predicted functional discharge outcomes.

supporting.claim: Adding neuro-athletic training improves goalkeepers' balance and agility.
supporting.context: An 8-week progressive neuro-athletic training program was tested against regular training in a randomized controlled trial.

supporting.claim: TRX suspension training improved movement quality and balance after ACL reconstruction.
supporting.context: In an RCT, 6 weeks of TRX outperformed traditional rehab in male athletes post-ACL reconstruction.

supporting.claim: Machine learning can grade post-stroke dysfunction severity from ICF data.
supporting.context: A machine learning framework classified stroke dysfunction severity using ICF-RS data from thousands of patients.

supporting.claim: Nerve transfer surgery holds promise for upper limb recovery after cervical SCI.
supporting.context: Literature analysis suggests positive aggregate outcomes but variable individual responses.
